lines.en: I've memorized the smell of this jungle.
My legs are stiff; one step, one pause.

lines.zh: 我隐两次身，你就找不到。
lines.en: I vanish twice, and you can't find me.
My shadow lags half a step behind.

lines.zh: 稀疏丛林里，我的鼓声传得远。
lines.en: My drum carries across the sparse jungle.
Vines underfoot. Step steady.
Under this mask I've been smiling all along.
Seven bends through the sparse wood.
My belly growls louder than the drum.

lines.zh: 稀疏丛林里，我的面具在响。
lines.en: In the sparse jungle, my mask rattles.
When the sun sets, my legs wake.
My growl bounces between the trees.
The moss on this stone looks like a face.
My arm stiffens like a dead branch.

lines.zh: 月亮把我的葫芦照得发白。
lines.en: The moon bleaches my gourd mask white.
Too much potion smoke. My head floats.
petals fell off again.
Standing as a crooked tree isn't bad.
Mallet raised. I forgot to strike.
Vines too thick. Not my spot.
Even insects are silent. Something's wrong.

lines.zh: 那片叶子自己晃了一下。
lines.en: That leaf stirred on its own.

lines.zh: 叶子都不动，你在抖什么。
lines.en: No leaf stirs. Why do you tremble?

lines.zh: 面具后面，我把你看了个透。
lines.en: Behind the mask, I see right through you.

lines.zh: 稀疏丛林的风，带骨灰味。
lines.en: Sparse jungle wind smells of bone ash.
Sweat and iron — that's a living thing.

lines.zh: 我还没敲鼓，你的心先响。
lines.en: I haven't drummed; your heart sounds first.

lines.zh: 我藏在稀疏丛林里，两次。
lines.en: I hide in sparse jungle, twice over.

lines.zh: 凑近些，我数数你几两魂。
lines.en: Step closer—let me count what your soul weighs.

lines.zh: 我隐身的时候，怪物还留在原地。
lines.en: When I vanish, my monsters stay put.

lines.zh: 你那把刀，我葫芦里装得下。
lines.en: That blade fits inside my gourd.

lines.zh: 我隐身两次，你只看得见一次。
lines.en: I vanish twice. You see me once.
Two vanishes and I'm still here.
Powder scattered everywhere, sharp in the nose.
I carve this blow into my bone bells.
The jungle witch doctor's mask cracked.
The mask cracked. The flesh holds.
I've marked your face. Wait.
The cauldron will brew one more cup.
A crack sounds beneath my mask.
The monsters stay. I step away.
My legs buckle; I grab a vine.
Iron filings in brew — I can swallow that.
That glimmer in your hand. Give it.

lines.zh: 我隐两次身，林子就空了。
lines.en: Two vanishings and the jungle is empty.

lines.zh: 丛林里没这么香的东西。
lines.en: Nothing in this jungle smells so rich.
You pass and the air turns sweet.

lines.zh: 你手里拿的是什么东西？
lines.en: What's that in your hand?
Fruit or meat? I can't tell.

lines.zh: 扔过来，我等着这颗果子。
lines.en: Toss it here; I am waiting for that fruit.
Stop waving. My claws aren't quick.

lines.zh: 我隐身两次，第二次你就不见了。
lines.en: I vanish twice; the second time you are gone.
Two vanishings in the jungle is enough.
Make way. My drum moves forward.
Bump again and my bone bells ring for you.
My bones nearly rattled apart.

lines.zh: 一根藤接住我，你运气好。
lines.en: A vine caught me. Count your luck.

lines.zh: 你把我的葫芦面具撞歪了。
lines.en: You knocked my gourd mask askew.

lines.zh: 我的面具，是用葫芦刻的。
lines.en: My mask is carved from a gourd.

lines.zh: 面具被撞歪了，脸露出来。
lines.en: The mask slipped; my face shows.
Behind this mask, my teeth are clenched.

lines.zh: 丛林深处，我的面具在响。
lines.en: Deep in the jungle, my mask rattles.

lines.zh: 我隐身两次，之后就别找我了。
lines.en: I vanish twice; after that, stop looking.
I recognize only you as my ingredient.
Those villagers only burn my drum.
Hiss again and I'll answer.
Three nights of drumming before you came.

lines.zh: 这么大的林子，你独个走？
lines.en: Such a jungle. You walk alone?
My teeth only graze. It won't hurt.
In the fork, where my gourd hangs.
Two vines laced together, room enough.
You smell of smoke — like home.
Pockets bulge and rattle as I walk.
Take it. Fine for hitting things.
A bone, just right for a bell.

lines.zh: 刀刃上刻着别人的记号。
lines.en: Another's mark is cut into this blade.
One more stuffed into my gourd.
On my head it looks like a mask.
Whatever's buried under flowers is mine.
Drop it in the cauldron and see.
My hand was half a step quicker.
Smells of medicine and meat.

lines.zh: 丛林这么密，你的心跳很响。
lines.en: The jungle is dense, and your heart is loud.

lines.zh: 面具下那双眼睛，早看你了。
lines.en: The eyes beneath this mask have watched you a while.
Go around behind this tree.
That shadow behind the tree is too wide.
Three bone-bell rings and I arrive.
My cauldron is one ingredient short.

lines.zh: 面具歪了，也挡不住我看你。
lines.en: Even a crooked mask doesn't block my view.
I leave the monsters right before you.
My mask is bigger than my face.
Your potion smell is too strong.

lines.zh: 你叫一声，整片林子都醒。
lines.en: One scream and the whole jungle wakes.
Vines knotted shut. No way back.

lines.zh: 鼓点一停，我就看见你了。
lines.en: The drum stopped, and there you were.

lines.zh: 我隐身两次，你只看见一次。
lines.en: I vanish twice. You see it once.

lines.zh: 好久没闻到喘气的东西。
lines.en: Long since I smelled anything breathing.
Run longer so my brew can settle.
Your arm's already slow; you still want to fight?
Your footprints are too deep in the jungle.
At night I keep my eyes open for prey.
I count every vine you snap.

lines.zh: 面具下面的牙，你猜不到。
lines.en: You can't guess the teeth under this mask.

lines.zh: 丛林的路，我认得每一根藤。
lines.en: I know every vine in this jungle.
The canopy is my ground too.
My cauldron is right behind that door.
This path is a dead end.

lines.zh: 我把怪物留在原地，自己走。
lines.en: I leave the monsters behind and walk away.

lines.zh: 你掉的火把，我先替你收着。
lines.en: I'll hold the torch you dropped.

lines.zh: 稀丛林里的脚步声，我听见了。
lines.en: Sparse-jungle footsteps. I hear them.

lines.zh: 喉音一停，你就该出来了。
lines.en: When my growl stops, come out.
Running won't shake me off.

lines.zh: 丛林这么深，喊也没人应。
lines.en: The jungle's too deep for shouts to carry.
Sweat mixed with iron. Closer.
I've carved marks on every tree.

lines.zh: 慢点，我还没敲完这轮鼓。
lines.en: Slow down. My round of drumming isn't done.
The vine bridge is shorter. I'll take it.
Breathing that hard, you can't hide.
Strength fills every joint of my bones.
Under my mask, I am still smiling.
Ten years swinging at tree stumps.
Vines hold your feet. Stand still.
One breath. One strike.
Bone and drum come down together.
I've vanished twice and you're still standing.

lines.zh: 药粉跟着拳头进了伤口。
lines.en: Potion dust rides my fist into the wound.
One rattle of bone bells, and the hex starts.
Iron won't stop my potion smoke.

lines.zh: 这一下，是我最后一次现身。
lines.en: This blow comes from my last appearance.

lines.zh: 面具下的眼睛，你看不见。
lines.en: Under my mask, you can't see my eyes.
The mallet comes down. Catch it.
Once my hand swings, it won't return.
After this growl, you lie down.
The jungle taught me no mercy.

lines.zh: 我一隐身，怪就留在原地。
lines.en: When I vanish, the monsters stay behind.
Nails dipped. Just one scratch.
The vine loop tightens. Don't pull.
The second lands on your ribs.
First, a wild cat to fill my belly.

lines.zh: 这声吼，是给整片林子的。
lines.en: This growl is for the whole wood.
Dirt still hangs from my mask.
No one answers my drum.
Darkness falls and my sight sharpens.
My legs aren't steady — let me lean.
Too bright here. I'll change trees.
I still know this vine.

lines.zh: 这里是哪，丛林这么稀疏。
lines.en: Where is this? The jungle is so sparse.
Drum hung. I'm not leaving.

lines.zh: 丛林太密，我一站起来就撞到叶。
lines.en: The jungle is dense; standing up, I hit leaves.
The drum stopped, so I woke.
Fire reached my mask.

lines.zh: 从树上下来这一下，扭到了。
lines.en: Coming down from that tree, I twisted something.
All my potion bottles are waterlogged.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的药罐子掀翻。
lines.en: The blast tipped over my potion jars.
An arrow through the leaves, into my shoulder.
These runes burn. I never learned them.
Three days unfed; I can't beat the drum.
The sparse jungle can't hide me.
I hide myself twice in the jungle.
